title: Personalized donor stationery

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study

slide_intent: Make recognition personal because supporters should see their own contribution within the institution’s identity.
strategic_value: Individually composed names can extend the Symphony’s variable typography into donor appreciation.
demonstration: A pale thank-you sheet sits beside five colored name cards with differently scaled letters.
practical_value: Use a shared type treatment to personalize names while retaining a consistent institutional signature.
